lines.text: Bay A humidity is holding. Keep an eye on CO₂ if algae spreads.
Rotate crops in Bay F if microbe health dips — I saw it on the board.
Reactor margins are thin. Don't starve engineering for ecology lighting.
If you smell ozone, check the electrolyzer before the engine.
Symptom live on the board — pick the failing loop before you burn more parts.
Wrong loop — parts wasted. Watch the SYS lights shake on your bad guess.
Cascade offline — upstream fault is starving downstream systems. Diagnose before maintain.
Election in days — mess hall rumors say your rep decides ecology vs reactor shares.
Bay F is sealed. Specimens only leave quarantine after ethics sign-off.
Warehouse queues grow when rations tighten. I need a captain call soon.
Exchange ledger is open. Surplus listings refresh each settlement.
Strict audit clears books fast — lenient keeps morale. Your call.
Specimens go through quarantine first — then hypothesis, then publish.
Alien assays fail more often — budget extra power to science if you can.
Two lathes run in parallel now. Queue fills when both are busy.
Nudge manufacturing power if you need parts yesterday.
Mess shift overlaps both crews. I prep while A works, serve while B eats.
Lee and I sync exchange meals — ask if rations feel tight.
Regulated exchange is live. All surplus trades go through my ledger now.
Three EEG anomalies share a frequency with the void sample. I did not put that in the public report.
Two bays show pollen that is not in our catalog. Burn or isolate — your call.
Someone left vine trimmings by the crawlway hatch. Mess staff are pretending not to see.
Coolant telemetry picked up a hum I cannot source. It syncs with science sample logs.
Deferred audit left holes in the ledger. Next shortage will look like theft.
Anonymous work order for lattice couplers — no project code. I stashed the printout.
